title: AI law firm Crosby bids on disintegrating, famed firm Weil Gotshal
slides: Can an AI law firm swallow Weil Gotshal?
Crosby just made a formal bid for the storied firm
Weil's partners are already splintering fast
Your legal bills could soon be priced by machines
Watch who leaves Weil next — that's the real tell
thread_text:
1. Weil's AI takeover bid

Crosby just made a formal offer for Weil Gotshal, one of the most storied law firms in the world. The deal would put an AI system in charge of legal work.

2. Partners are jumping ship

Weil's partners are already splintering fast, with top talent leaving before the ink dries. The exodus signals deep distrust in the firm's direction.

3. Your bills priced by machines

Legal fees could soon be set by algorithms, not billable hours. That means cheaper, faster work—but also less human judgment.

4. Watch who leaves next

The real tell isn't the bid itself, but who walks out the door next. If star partners keep leaving, the firm's value erodes fast.

5. Test AI on your own work

Take a simple legal task and run it through an AI tool today. If it saves time without sacrificing quality, ask yourself: would you pay a firm for that?
